# About

I am an Associate Professor at [Université Rouen-Normandie](https://www.agroparistech.fr) in the Laboratoire d'Economie Rouen Normandie ([LERN](https://lern.univ-rouen.fr/)).  

I defended my PhD thesis, supervised by [Alain Desdoigts](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=6c8QzJwAAAAJ&hl=fr), in July 2025 at [Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne University](https://www.pantheonsorbonne.fr/).

From 2025 to 2026, I was a Postdoctoral Researcher at [AgroParisTech](https://www.agroparistech.fr) in the Centre for International Research on Environment and Development ([CIRED](https://www.centre-cired.fr)), supervised by [Thierry Brunelle](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=70WNvUcAAAAJ&hl=fr).  

From 2023 to 2025, I was a Teaching Fellow (ATER) in the Department of Economics at [Sciences Po Paris](https://www.sciencespo.fr/fr/).

My research interests are primarily in development and agricultural economics.  

<hr style="border: 2px solid black;">

# Research

**Publications**

1. **Heterogeneous impacts of large scale land acquisitions on child nutrition in the Global South**, with [Julie Faure](https://scholar.google.com.tw/citations?user=S2iiM2kAAAAJ&hl=ja) et al. <br> *Forthcoming* at [**Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences**](https://www.pnas.org/).  

2. **The impact of large-scale land acquisitions on food security in Africa**. <br> [**World Development**](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.worlddev.2024.106597), 179, July 2024. [PDF](PDF/Castet_2024_World_Development.pdf)  

3. **Food security and Covid-19: An analysis of the MENA region**, with [Racha Ramadan](https://www.racharamadan.com/). <br> [**Revue d’Économie du Développement**](https://www.cairn.info/revue-d-economie-du-developpement-2023-3-page-29.htm?contenu=article), 33(3–4), 2023. [PDF](PDF/Castet_Ramadan_2023_RED.pdf)

**Work in progress**

1. **Climate Change and Gendered Structural Transformation in Africa**, with [Kibrom Abay](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=-ga5p8UAAAAJ&hl=en) and [Martin Paul Jr.Tabe-Ojong](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=OwxVewYAAAAJ&hl=en). <br> *R & R* at [**Journal of Development Economics**](https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-development-economics).

3. **The Economic Analysis of Maize Intensification**, with [Thierry Brunelle](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=70WNvUcAAAAJ&hl=fr) and [Tristan Le Cotty](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=i4tcjnsAAAAJ&hl=fr).

4. **Do transportation costs drive fertilizer prices? Evidence from Sub-Saharan Africa**, with [Thierry Brunelle](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=70WNvUcAAAAJ&hl=fr) and [Tristan Le Cotty](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=i4tcjnsAAAAJ&hl=fr).
